title: Asset service
interface: Exceptions AssetValidationError(ValueError), DuplicateAssetTag(ValueError). class AssetService(assets: AssetRepository, audit: AuditRepository). create(actor, asset_tag, type, brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date, price, notes) -> dict: strips and upper-cases asset_tag (empty -> AssetValidationError), type must be in config.ASSET_TYPES, purchase_date '' or ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (else AssetValidationError), price coerced to float (invalid -> AssetValidationError); sqlite3.IntegrityError from the repository -> DuplicateAssetTag; records audit 'asset.created'. get(id) -> dict | None. update(actor, asset_id, **fields) -> dict (same validation for the fields given; unknown id -> AssetValidationError; audit 'asset.updated'). retire(actor, asset_id) -> dict and mark_lost(actor, asset_id) -> dict: refuse (AssetValidationError) when the asset status is 'assigned', 'pending_handover' or 'pending_return'; set status 'retired'/'lost'; audit 'asset.retired'/'asset.lost'. list(status=None, type=None, q='') -> list[dict] (search when q given, then filter by status/type). Never catch generic Exception.

uses.AuditRepository: src/repositories/audit.py: record(actor, action, entity, entity_id, details)
uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES, load_config(overrides) -> dict
